issues.title: Dangling External Module References
issues.why: The spec explicitly references sibling modules (02, 03, 04, 17, 22, 27) as normative dependencies, but their content is not provided in the context, preventing 100% confidence in cross-module rule application.
issues.fix: Provide the 00-overview.md and 97-acceptance-criteria.md for all referenced sibling modules.

issues.title: Linter Script Implementation Gap
issues.why: The spec mandates specific linter behaviors (e.g., check-lockstep.cjs, audit-spec-vs-code-v2.py) and exit codes, but the logic for these scripts is described via metadata rather than implementation-ready logic.
issues.fix: Include the core logic or pseudo-code for the 6 mandatory linter gates described in the lifecycle.

issues.title: Version/Phase Discrepancy
issues.why: The metadata block lists Version 4.13.3 and Phase 153, but the 'Inlined Contract' section refers to Phase 48 and Phase 52, creating potential confusion on which schema version is current.
issues.fix: Synchronize all inlined JSON schemas and contract blocks to the current Phase 153 versioning.
